shown.description: Move the motor stator, the gearbox assembly and the screw drive and the control boards and 1 other part to Canada

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, all major functional components (DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, housings, sensor PCBA, and electrical apparatus) are produced in China, and final assembly in Canada does not substantially transform them. In Variant B, production of the DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, sensor PCBA, and electrical apparatus moves to Canada, leaving only the housings sourced from China. Under CBP precedent (e.g., N346961 and N346297), the motor, gearbox/drive mechanism, and PCBA are the primary functional components that impart the essential character of electromechanical drive devices, making Canada the country of origin.

In Variant B, the 12 VDC brushed motor—which imparts the essential character of an electrical actuator (classified as an electric motor under heading 8501, per N342620)—is manufactured in-house in Canada and combined there with the Chinese gearbox and other components. As in N346297 (where producing the core electric motor subassembly in the country of final assembly with a Chinese gearbox conferred origin), origin shifts to Canada.

draft.question:
What is the country of origin of DC motor actuator, produced as described above, under the Part 102 rules of origin (the general rules of 19 C.F.R. § 102.11, applied in order, with the tariff shifts of § 102.20), for purposes of country of origin marking (19 C.F.R. § 102.0)?

This request concerns the origin of the merchandise for marking under the Part 102 rules only. It does not ask CBP to decide the country of origin for Section 301 duties, which is a separate question, and the requester does not contend that marking origin settles it.
draft.tariff_shift: Tariff-shift check (19 C.F.R. § 102.20): applied to the component codes in the bill of materials, with the good finished in Canada, the rule gives Canada (19 C.F.R. § 102.11(a)(3); 19 C.F.R. § 102.20(o), 8501). [CONFIRM WITH COUNSEL]
